description: Find the Jaryo entity for a Korean company from its name (Korean or English) or an official identifier: business registration number (biz_no, 10 digits), corporate registration number (corp_reg_no, 13 digits), DART corp code (8 digits) or KONEPS vendor id. Returns candidates with confidence. Requires a Jaryo API key (free: https://jaryo.org/keys/). (한국 회사 찾기)

g2b_vendor_id.description: KONEPS (나라장터) vendor id = business registration number

name.description: Company name, Korean or English (2+ characters), or a stock code (6 digits)

name: resolve_company
title: Resolve a Korean company
